Claim 1. (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, wherein the station includes a processor programmed to receive operator acknowledgment input, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor that is perceptually distinct from the first alarm.

Claim 16. (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to receive acknowledgment status of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and an acknowledgment status indicator; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the system is configured to escalate the alarm if acknowledgment is not received within a predetermined time interval.

Claim 17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system, and wherein the system is configured to transmit escalation notifications to remote devices when the alarm is not acknowledged.

Claim 18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm and a timestamp associated with each escalation level.

Claim 19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, including an identifier of the person acknowledging the alarm and a time of acknowledgement.

Claim 20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices __based on the escalation status of the alarm__.
